summary.verdict_desc: 本期计数 6 红 / 8 黄 / 11 绿，红灯比例连续第 5 期钉在 24.0%、加权风险分 40.0%，两轴（泡沫成熟度 60.0 亢奋 / 破裂临近度 26.7 零星火花）与 6 个类别分与上期逐位一致，无一指标发生颜色迁移（动量净 0）。先说清节奏：本期距 Issue #20（8/16）只隔 1 天，慢变量序列（CAPE、季度 FCF、企业部署率）本就不该移动，头条静止不构成信息。本期真正的内容是数据管线本身——GitHub Actions 机械 prefetch 首次全量供数，四个此前 egress 受限的源（EDGAR / OpenRouter / SSGA / FRED）一次性全部 status=ok，把三个挂了数周的估算换成了实测值，而其中两个的真值与看板上挂的数字相差很大，且方向相反：① 内部人卖买比：估算 25x → 实测 442.8x（12 家 30 日卖出 $4.115 亿 / 买入 $92.9 万、92 份 Form 4）。量级差一个数量级，但更值得读的是结构——绝对卖压其实只有 $4 亿、84% 来自 AMZN 一家，NVDA/AVGO/ORCL/ARM 本窗口零成交额，红灯完全由买盘归零驱动而非卖压放量；同一次抓取还证伪了上期 note 里「黄仁勋 8/6、8/8 各减 7.5 万股」（EDGAR 中不存在，属被封期间的错误锚定）。② 行业 token 量：估算约 100-125T/月（数据已 10-12 周旧）→ 实测近 30 日 275.0 万亿、前 30 日 218.5 万亿、环比 +25.9%。真实量级是此前挂牌值的两倍以上，需求侧被系统性低估了两个多月；这条线的含义从「没有收缩」升级为「明确在加速」。③ 前 5 权重：二手估算约 28% → SSGA 官方持仓 27.21%（含 Alphabet 双类 29.63%、前 10 37.58%），偏高约 0.8pt。④ HY OAS：镜像读数 → FRED 官方 API 确认 271bps（观测日 8/13）。关键结论：三处修正合计造成 0 次颜色迁移、0.0pt 红灯比例变化——过去五周降级数据下的判读结论是稳的；但支撑它的两个数字一个低估了引线（内部人）、一个低估了基本面（token），只是恰好相互抵消。另有一处台账修正：frontier_progress 的主锚 METR 倍增时间按官方 Time Horizon 1.1 口径为 196 天（约 7 个月），台账此前记的「约 4 个月」实为 2024 年起子区间；修正后仍卡在「≤7 个月=绿」的边界上，叠加主力基准 ARC-AGI-2 已被 GPT-5.5 推到约 85% 逼近饱和（下期起按规则轮换到 ARC-AGI-3），这是全表最需要下期复核的一格绿灯。宏观边际本期反而缓和：9/16 会议 CME FedWatch 隐含维持概率由上期约 50% 的五五开回到 67.6%（加息 32%），上期那次「全期最接近红线」暂时退坡；capex_reaction 与 ceo_hedging 维持黄——承认过热的一侧本期已到 Altman（「投资者整体过度兴奋」）、Pichai（「非理性」「没有公司能幸免，包括我们」）、Dimon（「很可能有一大部分会亏掉」）三人，反向仅 Huang 独扛，但无一家在承认的同时收缩 capex，故不转红。信用面仍是最强支撑（类别分 25.0）：HY OAS 271bps 处最紧十分位，DC ABS 的 AAA 段最紧且 SEC 8/10 证券化豁免仍在给供给端松绑；但要害在分层——Penn Mutual 8/6 的利差全景显示 merchant/greenfield 段与 IG 段价差在扩大，Morningstar 报 AI 债发行破 $2500 亿、hyperscaler 债认购覆盖率由 2 月约 5 倍降至 7 月不足 2 倍，边际融资正转向私募信用。本周新增 deal 仅 Global AI $4.41 亿（JPM 牵头、8/10），无 ≥$10B，台账累计约 $129.0B，比值维持约 55% 黄灯。资金面维持唯一破 85 的类别分（87.5）：Mag4 FCF 红（Meta Q2 -91%、Amazon TTM -$76 亿，Amazon 2026 capex $2000 亿预计超其经营现金流）、AI 占全球 VC 逾 70%、NVDA 客户投资/收入约 43%（循环资金环多家统计已置于 $8000 亿以上）。市场结构侧广度实抓约 64%（8/13 收盘，周内一度触及 70%、为 1 月以来首次；200 日线上方逾 72% 为 2024/12 以来最广）守绿，无 2000 式头部独撑。判读：基础档位按 red_pct 24.0%（<25）本落观察期，但估值 2 红（CAPE、前 5 权重）叠加资金面 3 红（Mag4 FCF、VC 占比、NVDA 客户投资）触发**估值 + 资金面双类共振强制升级**，维持高风险预警；两轴升级（stage≥60 且 trigger≥50）因 trigger 仅 26.7 未触发，降档滞回不适用。历史相似度：颜色向量与上期一致，最像 2000-02（互联网泡沫顶前 1 个月，76%），次为 1999-06（70%）、2021-11（68%），2007-10（41%）最不像。与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）向量的主要差异仍是五处：NVDA 远期 PE 仍便宜（约 24x vs 2000 龙头约 60x）、市场广度仍绿（约 64%）、宽口径 HY 信用仍紧（271bps vs 2000 走阔）、AI IPO 未成洪流（Anthropic 公开 S-1 至 8/17 仍未释出 EDGAR、瞄准 8-9 月）、Fed 为维持而非明确加息。本期这五处差异中，Fed 反向走宽（维持概率回到 67.6%），其余四处未动——也就是说与顶前一个月的距离本期没有缩短。分母提醒：N=25 下 6 红对应 24.0%，跨期趋势以方向为主。一句话：头条第五周钉在 24%，但这一期的价值不在头条而在体温计本身——机械 prefetch 上线后，内部人比值被上修一个数量级、token 量被上修一倍有余，两处相反的偏差恰好抵消掉了，判读没变；接下来真正该盯的是 Anthropic 公开 S-1、Nvidia 8/26 财报，以及 METR 倍增时间与 ARC-AGI-2 饱和这两处已经松动的绿灯。（动量净 0，未及 ±4 阈值。）
summary.verdict_desc_en: This period prints 6 red / 8 yellow / 11 green, with the red share pinned at 24.0% for a fifth straight reading and the weighted risk score at 40.0%; the two axes (bubble maturity 60.0 Euphoria, rupture proximity 26.7 Sparks) and all six category scores match last period digit for digit, with no indicator changing color (net momentum 0). First, on cadence: this issue lands just one day after Issue #20 (Aug 16), so slow-moving series — CAPE, quarterly free cash flow, enterprise deployment — were never going to move, and a frozen headline carries no information. The substance of this issue is the data pipeline itself. The mechanical GitHub Actions prefetch job supplied a full set of readings for the first time, with all four previously egress-blocked sources (EDGAR, OpenRouter, SSGA, FRED) reporting status ok at once, replacing three multi-week estimates with measured values — and in two cases the truth diverged sharply from what the dashboard had been showing, in opposite directions. (1) The insider sell/buy ratio: an estimated 25x became a measured 442.8x ($411.5M of sales against $0.9M of purchases across the 12-name basket over 30 days, from 92 Form 4 filings). That is an order of magnitude, but the structure matters more — absolute selling is only about $400M, 84% of it is Amazon alone, and NVDA, AVGO, ORCL and ARM recorded no dollar volume in the window, so the red light is driven entirely by buying vanishing rather than by a surge in selling. The same pull also disproves last period's claim that Huang sold 75k shares on Aug 6 and Aug 8; no such filings exist in EDGAR, and the line was mis-anchored while the source was blocked. (2) Industry token volume: an estimate of roughly 100-125T per month, already 10-12 weeks stale, became a measured 275.0 trillion over the last 30 days versus 218.5 trillion in the prior 30, up 25.9%. The true level is more than double what was published, meaning demand was systematically understated for over two months, and the meaning of the line upgrades from 'not contracting' to 'clearly accelerating.' (3) Top-5 weight: a secondary estimate of ~28% became 27.21% from SSGA's official holdings file (29.63% counting Alphabet's dual classes, 37.58% for the Top-10), about 0.8 points lower. (4) HY OAS: mirror quotes gave way to the official FRED API confirming 271bps as of the Aug 13 observation. The key conclusion: those three corrections together produced zero color changes and a 0.0-point move in the red share. The verdict drawn from five weeks of degraded data held up — but of the two numbers underpinning it, one understated the fuse (insiders) and the other understated the fundamentals (tokens), and they happened to cancel out. One further ledger correction: METR's doubling time, the primary anchor for frontier_progress, is 196 days (about seven months) under the official Time Horizon 1.1 methodology, whereas the ledger had been carrying '~4 months,' which was the post-2024 sub-period. Corrected, it sits exactly on the 'within seven months equals green' boundary, and with GPT-5.5 pushing ARC-AGI-2 to roughly 85% and near saturation (the spec calls for rotating to ARC-AGI-3 from next period), this is the green cell most in need of re-checking. The macro margin actually eased: CME FedWatch's implied hold probability for the Sept 16 meeting recovered from last period's near coin flip to 67.6%, with 32% on a hike, so the closest approach to the red line all run has stepped back for now. capex_reaction and ceo_hedging stay yellow — the acknowledging side now includes Altman ('investors as a whole are overexcited'), Pichai ('irrationality,' 'no company is going to be immune, including us') and Dimon ('a lot of that money will probably be lost'), with Huang largely alone on the other side, but nobody is conceding an overheated market while cutting capex, so it does not turn red. Credit remains the strongest support (category 25.0): HY OAS at 271bps sits in the tightest decile, the AAA data-center ABS strip is tighter still, and the SEC's Aug 10 securitization exemption keeps easing supply. The exposure is in the tiering — Penn Mutual's Aug 6 spread survey shows the merchant/greenfield tranche pulling away from investment grade, and Morningstar reports AI-backing bond issuance past $250B with hyperscaler coverage ratios falling from about 5x in February to under 2x by July as the marginal dollar shifts to private credit. The only new deal this week is JPMorgan's $441M facility for Global AI on Aug 10, nothing at or above $10B, leaving the ledger near $129.0B for the year and the ratio at ~55%, yellow. Capital stays the only category above 85 (87.5): Mag4 free cash flow is red (Meta's Q2 down 91%, Amazon's trailing FCF at -$7.6B, with $200B of 2026 capex set to exceed operating cash flow), AI takes more than 70% of global venture dollars, and NVDA customer investment runs about 43% of revenue (several tallies now put the circular loop above $800B). On market structure, breadth measured about 64% at the Aug 13 close after touching 70% intraweek for the first time since January, with more than 72% above the 200-day line — the broadest since December 2024 — holding green with no 2000-style narrow leadership. Verdict: the base framework sits at Observation on a red share of 24.0% (<25), but valuation at 2 red (CAPE, Top-5 weight) plus capital at 3 red (Mag4 FCF, VC share, NVDA customer investment) fires the dual-category resonance override, holding High Risk Alert; the two-axis upgrade (stage >=60 and trigger >=50) does not fire because trigger is only 26.7, and the downgrade hysteresis does not apply. Historical similarity: the color vector matches last period, resembling 2000-02 most closely (1 month before dot-com top, 76%), then June 1999 (70%) and November 2021 (68%), with October 2007 (41%) least alike. The gaps versus the February 2000 vector remain the same five: NVDA's forward PE is still cheap (~24x against ~60x for 2000's leaders), breadth is still green (~64%), broad high-yield credit is still tight (271bps versus widening in 2000), the AI IPO pipeline is not yet a flood (Anthropic's public S-1 still absent from EDGAR as of Aug 17, targeting August-September), and the Fed is holding rather than clearly hiking. Of those five, the Fed gap widened back out this period and the other four did not move — the distance to the top's eve did not shorten. Denominator reminder: with N=25, six reds map to 24.0%, so cross-period trends should be read by direction. In one line: the headline is pinned at 24% for a fifth week, but this issue's value is in the thermometer rather than the reading — with the mechanical prefetch live, the insider ratio was revised up by an order of magnitude and token volume by more than double, two opposite errors that happened to cancel, leaving the verdict unchanged; what actually deserves watching next is Anthropic's public S-1, Nvidia's Aug 26 print, and the two greens that have already loosened, METR's doubling time and ARC-AGI-2's saturation. (Net momentum 0, below the +/-4 threshold.)

wow_changes.note: 本期最重要的数据修复：prefetch 直连 SEC EDGAR，首次拿到 12 家 30 日（7/18-8/17）Form 4 聚合真值——卖出 $4.115 亿 / 买入 $92.9 万 = 442.8x（92 份申报）。此前 5 期挂的「约 25x」是被封期间的方向性估算，方向对、量级差一个数量级；同期还证伪了上期 note 里「黄仁勋 8/6、8/8 各减 7.5 万股」——EDGAR 中并不存在。注意绝对卖压其实只有 $4 亿量级、且 84% 来自 AMZN 一家，红灯真正的驱动是买盘归零。suspect_static 解除
wow_changes.note_en: The week's most important data repair: the prefetch job now hits SEC EDGAR directly and produced the first measured 30-day aggregate for the 12-name basket (Jul 18-Aug 17) — $411.5M of sales against $0.9M of purchases, a 442.8x ratio across 92 filings. The '~25x' carried for five periods was a directional estimate made while the source was blocked: right in direction, off by an order of magnitude. The same pull also disproves last period's claim that Huang sold 75k shares on Aug 6 and Aug 8 — no such filings exist in EDGAR. Note that absolute selling is only ~$400M and 84% of it is Amazon alone; what actually drives the red light is that buying has gone to zero. The suspect-static flag is cleared

wow_changes.note: 停更约 10-12 周后恢复真值：prefetch 走 OpenRouter 官方 datasets API，近 30 日 275.0 万亿 tokens、前 30 日 218.5 万亿、环比 +25.9%（截至 8/16）。真实量级是此前挂牌估算（约 100-125T/月）的两倍以上，且行业 token 消耗仍在两位数加速——这条线过去两个多月被系统性低估。状态维持绿灯，但读数含义从「没有收缩」升级为「明确在加速」
wow_changes.note_en: Restored after roughly 10-12 weeks dark: the prefetch job pulls OpenRouter's official datasets API, showing 275.0 trillion tokens over the last 30 days versus 218.5 trillion in the prior 30, up 25.9% through Aug 16. The true level is more than double the '~100-125T per month' the dashboard had been carrying, and consumption is still compounding at a double-digit rate — this line was systematically understated for over two months. The status stays green, but the meaning of the reading upgrades from 'not contracting' to 'clearly accelerating'

wow_changes.note: 上期是全期最接近红线的一次（维持概率滑到约 50%），本期回撤：CME FedWatch 对 9/16 会议隐含维持 3.50-3.75% 概率回到 67.6%、加息 32%。7 月会议以 9:3 投票维持，通胀黏性令加息辩论未息、部分卖方仍写「9 月加息已成预期」，但模态读数已重新拉开与红线的距离，维持黄灯
wow_changes.note_en: Last period marked the closest approach to the red line all run, with the hold probability sliding to roughly 50%; this period it backed off. CME FedWatch now implies a 67.6% chance the Sept 16 meeting holds at 3.50-3.75% against 32% for a hike. July held on a 9-3 vote and sticky inflation keeps the hike debate alive — some sell-side notes still headline a September hike as expected — but the modal read has re-opened its distance from the red line, so this stays yellow

wow_changes.note: 口径升级而非市场变动：slickcharts 返回 403 后，prefetch 已切 SSGA SPY 官方日度持仓 XLSX，前 5 单类权重 27.21%（NVDA 8.13 / AAPL 6.68 / MSFT 5.50 / AMZN 3.87 / GOOGL 3.03），含 Alphabet 双类 29.63%、前 10 为 37.58%。此前数期的「约 28%」偏高约 0.8pt。集中度仍远超 25% 红线，红灯不变
wow_changes.note_en: A source upgrade rather than a market move: after Slickcharts returned 403, the prefetch job switched to SSGA's official daily SPY holdings file, putting the single-class Top-5 at 27.21% (NVDA 8.13, AAPL 6.68, MSFT 5.50, AMZN 3.87, GOOGL 3.03), 29.63% counting both Alphabet classes and 37.58% for the Top-10. The '~28%' carried in recent periods ran about 0.8 points high. Concentration remains far above the 25% red line, so the red light is unchanged

wow_changes.note: 周度边际转薄：本周唯一新 deal 是 JPMorgan 牵头给 Global AI 的 $4.41 亿融资（8/10），无单笔 ≥$10B，台账年内累计约 $129.0B、比值维持约 55% 黄灯。真正的边际在价不在量——Morningstar 本期报支撑 AI 投资的债券发行已破 $2500 亿并在测试投资者需求上限，hyperscaler 债认购覆盖率由 2 月约 5 倍降至 7 月不足 2 倍，边际融资正由公开债市转向私募信用
wow_changes.note_en: The weekly margin thinned: the only new deal is JPMorgan's $441M facility for Global AI on Aug 10, with nothing at or above $10B, leaving the ledger's year-to-date traceable flow near $129.0B and the ratio at ~55%, yellow. The real movement is in price rather than volume — Morningstar reported this period that bond issuance backing AI investment has passed $250B and is testing the ceiling of investor demand, with coverage on hyperscaler deals falling from about 5x in February to under 2x by July as the marginal dollar migrates from public bonds to private credit

indicators.note_en: Re-checked this run with no change: Anthropic's Caplight-implied value is ~$1.2T, a ~24% premium to its $965B Series H, with Caplight's CEO describing demand as far outstripping supply and almost nobody selling; OpenAI is ~$908B on Caplight and ~$880B on Forge, just 3% above its $852B primary. indicators.threshold_text_en: Guidance cut = red / Accelerating = yellow / Steady = green
indicators.note: Q2 财报季已结束、本期无新指引，沿用台账口径：MSFT FY27 约 $255-260B、Meta 2026 约 $130-145B、Amazon 约 $220B（2025 为 $132B）、Google 约 $195-205B，四大 2026e 合计约 $740-770B、YoY 约 +80%。无一家下调，绝对增速仍在加速、不可持续特征明显，维持黄灯；Nvidia 8/26 财报为下一个催化点
indicators.note_en: Q2 season is closed and no new guidance landed this period, so the ledger carries: MSFT FY27 ~$255-260B, Meta 2026 ~$130-145B, Amazon ~$220B (from $132B in 2025) and Google ~$195-205B — roughly $740-770B combined for 2026, about +80% YoY. Nobody has cut, and the pace is still accelerating with clear marks of unsustainability — yellow; Nvidia's Aug 26 print is the next catalyst

indicators.threshold_text_en: <-20% red / -20%~0 yellow / >0 green
indicators.note: 季度指标、本期无新披露，沿用 Q2 台账：Meta Q2 FCF $784M（同比约 -91%）、Amazon TTM FCF 转负 -$76 亿、Alphabet Q2 -$58.55 亿，仅 MSFT 仍正 $196 亿。交叉印证仍成立——Amazon 2026 capex $200B 预计超过其经营现金流。Mag4 多数由造现金转向吞现金、被迫转向外部融资，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: A quarterly measure with no new disclosure this period, so Q2 carries: Meta's Q2 FCF was $784M (about -91% YoY), Amazon's trailing-twelve-month FCF turned negative at -$7.6B and Alphabet's Q2 was -$5.855B, leaving only MSFT positive at $19.6B. The cross-check still holds — Amazon's $200B of 2026 capex is expected to exceed its operating cash flow. Most of the Mag4 have flipped from generating cash to consuming it and must lean on external financing — red

indicators.name_zh: AI 占 VC 投资比重
indicators.threshold_text_en: >50% red / 30-50% yellow / <30% green
indicators.note: 半年度硬数据、本期无新 Q3 完整读数（PitchBook 已出 Q3 专题《Fewer Deals, Bigger Bets》但无季度占比总量）：沿用 PitchBook/Crunchbase H1 2026——AI 占全球创投逾 70%（一年前不足 50%）、占美国创投 86%（$355.9B / 全美 $412.7B）；H1 全球创投创纪录 $510B，OpenAI+Anthropic 两家独占 43%（$217B）。远超 50% 红线且集中度续升，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: A semi-annual hard series with no complete Q3 print this period (PitchBook has published a Q3 feature, 'Fewer Deals, Bigger Bets,' but no quarterly share total), so PitchBook/Crunchbase H1 2026 carries: AI took more than 70% of global venture dollars, up from under 50% a year earlier, and 86% of US venture ($355.9B of $412.7B); global H1 venture hit a record $510B with OpenAI and Anthropic alone absorbing 43% ($217B). Far above the 50% red line with concentration still rising — red

indicators.threshold_text_en: >30% red / 15-30% yellow / <15% green (Lucent '99 peak: 24%)
indicators.note: 长期常红（原始值台账内连续第 6 期为红，实际更久）、二阶维持在再扩张区间但本期无新增承诺：直接股权承诺仍约 $40B（OpenAI $30B）÷ 约 $300B LTM 收入 ≈ 43%，远超 Lucent 1999 峰值 24%。上期新增的 Nvidia 向华尔街寻约 $500B 融资承诺（含 OpenAI $250B 俄亥俄背书 + $350B 芯片采购融资）本期无更新；本期新增的只是口径印证——多家统计把整个循环资金环规模置于 $800B 以上（芯片商→AI 实验室→云厂→回到芯片）。维持红灯
indicators.note_en: A persistent red with the second order still in expansion territory, though no new commitment landed this period: direct equity pledges remain ~$40B (OpenAI $30B) against ~$300B of LTM revenue, roughly 43% and far above Lucent's 1999 peak of 24%. Last period's news — Nvidia seeking a ~$500B funding commitment from Wall Street, covering the $250B Ohio backstop for OpenAI plus ~$350B of chip-purchase financing — saw no update. What is new is only corroboration of scale: several tallies now put the whole circular loop (chipmaker to AI lab to cloud and back to chips) above $800B — red

indicators.threshold_text_en: <40% red / 40-60% yellow / >60% green
indicators.note: 本期实抓（Bull Bear Report，8/14 当周）：周四 8/13 收盘约 64% 个股在 50 日线上方，周内一度触及 70%——为 1 月以来首次；200 日线上方比例逾 72%，为 2024 年 12 月以来最广参与度（春季低点仅 41%），个股间相关性接近历史最低。指数在所有主要均线之上、较 200 日线高约 10%（延展偏大）。广度与指数同向、无 2000 式头部独撑，守绿；估算成分仅限于把 8/13 收盘外推到周末（barchart/investing 实时源仍受限，无 prefetch 覆盖）
indicators.note_en: Pulled this run (Bull Bear Report, week of Aug 14): roughly 64% of S&P 500 members closed above their 50-day average on Thursday Aug 13, after touching 70% intraweek — the first such reading since January. More than 72% sit above their 200-day line, the broadest participation since December 2024 (versus a washed-out 41% this spring), and cross-stock correlation is near record lows. The index is above every major moving average and about 10% above its 200-day, which is stretched. Breadth is moving with the index, with no 2000-style narrow leadership — green; the only estimated element is carrying the Aug 13 close through to the weekend, since Barchart/Investing live feeds remain restricted and this indicator has no prefetch coverage

indicators.name_zh: AI 龙头内部人卖买比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >20x = red / 5-20x = yellow / <5x = green (2000 peak: 23x)
indicators.note: 连续 5 期估算沿用后，本期首次拿到真实聚合原始数据点：prefetch 直接从 SEC EDGAR Form 4 聚合 12 家 30 日（7/18-8/17）公开市场交易——卖出 $4.115 亿 / 买入 $92.9 万，比值 442.8x，共 92 份 Form 4。分票：AMZN $3.467 亿（占 84%）、MU $3817 万、GOOGL $963 万、MSFT $727 万、PLTR $595 万、META $364 万；唯一买盘来自 TSM $92.9 万，NVDA/AVGO/ORCL/ARM 本窗口零成交额。value 按口径取 min(ratio, 99)。要点：绝对卖压其实只有 $4 亿量级（并不惊人），红灯主要由买盘归零驱动——上期 note 里的「黄仁勋 8/6、8/8 各减 7.5 万股」在 EDGAR 中不存在（属被封期间的错误锚定），本期已由真值取代。suspect_static 随之解除
indicators.note_en: After five straight periods of carried estimates, this run finally has a real aggregate data point: the prefetch job aggregates SEC EDGAR Form 4 filings directly across the 12-name basket for the 30 days from Jul 18 to Aug 17 — $411.5M of open-market sales against $0.9M of purchases, a 442.8x ratio drawn from 92 filings. By name: AMZN $346.7M (84% of the total), MU $38.2M, GOOGL $9.6M, MSFT $7.3M, PLTR $5.9M and META $3.6M; the only buying was TSM's $0.9M, while NVDA, AVGO, ORCL and ARM recorded no dollar volume in the window. Per the spec the stored value is capped at min(ratio, 99). The important nuance: absolute selling is only ~$400M, which is not itself alarming — the red light is driven by buying having vanished. The prior note's claim that Huang sold 75k shares each on Aug 6 and Aug 8 does not appear in EDGAR at all (it was mis-anchored while the source was blocked) and is now replaced by measured data. The suspect-static flag is cleared

indicators.threshold_text: 洪流=红 / 升温=黄 / 平静=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Flood = red / Warming = yellow / Quiet = green
indicators.note: 本期复核：Anthropic 至 8/17 仍未在 EDGAR 释出公开 S-1（6/1 保密交表、$965B Series H 后），未定价格区间、股数、代码与承销商，市场预期公开 S-1 落在 8-9 月、路演与定价在 10-11 月。旁证在增多——分析师已把 Anthropic、OpenAI（部分口径称瞄准 9 月/Q4、$1T+，另一口径仍称倾向 2027）与 SpaceX（S-1 已交、拟募至多 $75B、估值 $1.75T）三家并称同场排队。但 6 个月内实质临近发行的 AI 标的仍只 Anthropic 一家、总数远不足 10，未达「洪流」门槛，维持黄灯；公开 S-1 一旦释出即为本指标最可能的转红触发
indicators.note_en: Re-checked this run: as of Aug 17 Anthropic still has no public S-1 or S-1/A on EDGAR (it filed confidentially on June 1, after the $965B Series H), with no price range, share count, ticker or underwriters announced; the market expects a public filing in August-September and a roadshow and pricing in October-November. The circumstantial evidence is thickening — analysts now describe Anthropic, OpenAI (some reports point to September/Q4 at $1T+, others still say it leans 2027) and SpaceX (S-1 filed, raising up to $75B at a $1.75T valuation) as queuing together. But Anthropic remains the only AI name genuinely within six months of listing, far short of the ten-plus that would mark a flood — yellow, with a public S-1 the most likely trigger to turn this red

indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: 源头升级：本期起改由 prefetch 走 FRED 官方 API 直取 BAMLH0A0HYM2（此前数期为 Convex/TradingEconomics 镜像）。本期原始读数 271bps（观测日 8/13），近 5 个观测日为 271/271/272/270/270，走势平坦、仍远低于长期均值约 394bps 与中位数约 452bps，处历史最紧十分位。宽口径信用对 AI 风险仍无压力，是当前最支撑多头的一格；但因 271 已连续 3 期入账，按纪律标 suspect_static（属真实平坦而非沿用，见 static 说明）。并读提醒：AI/DC 高收益债与 merchant DC 债自 6 月起的分层走阔并未反映在这条宽口径里
indicators.note_en: Source upgrade: from this period the reading comes from the prefetch job pulling BAMLH0A0HYM2 straight off the official FRED API, replacing several weeks of Convex/TradingEconomics mirrors. This run's raw print is 271bps as of the Aug 13 observation, with the last five observations at 271/271/272/270/270 — flat, and still far below the ~394bps long-run average and ~452bps median, in the historically tightest decile. Broad credit registers no stress from AI risk and remains the single most bull-supportive cell on the board. Because 271 has now been booked three periods running, discipline requires the suspect-static flag, though here it reflects a genuinely flat market rather than a carried value. One caveat to read alongside: the tiered widening in AI/data-center high yield and merchant data-center bonds since June does not show up in this broad index

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ = 红 / 稳定 = 黄 / 收窄 = 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widening 50bps+ = red / Stable = yellow / Tightening = green
indicators.note: AAA 级 DC ABS 侧仍是整个 AI 债复合体最紧的一段：KBRA 续给新发预评级（DataBank 2026-1 等），2026 年 DC 证券化发行量预计逾 $40B（2025 为 $27B）、约占全美 ABS 一成；SEC 8/10 对一大类 DC 证券化豁免关键披露与投资者保护要求，供给端仍松。基准 AAA 利差未现 50bps+ 走阔，维持绿灯。边际应力并读：Penn Mutual 8/6 的 AI 基建债利差全景显示分层明显，merchant/greenfield 段（如 8/13 Jane Street 承租的 $2.25B 绿色 DC 债 5 年期近 9%）与投资级段的价差在扩大
indicators.note_en: The AAA data-center ABS strip remains the tightest segment of the entire AI-debt complex: KBRA keeps pre-rating new issues such as DataBank 2026-1, 2026 data-center securitization volume is tracking above $40B against $27B in 2025 (roughly a tenth of all US ABS), and the SEC's Aug 10 exemption of a large subset of these deals from key disclosure and investor-protection rules keeps supply flowing. Benchmark AAA spreads show no 50bps-plus widening — green. The strain to read alongside it: Penn Mutual's Aug 6 survey of AI-infrastructure bond spreads shows clear tiering, with the gap between the merchant/greenfield tranche (the Jane Street-leased $2.25B green data-center bond of Aug 13 priced near 9% for five years) and investment-grade paper still widening

indicators.threshold_text: 任何违约/降级=红 / Watch=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any default/downgrade = red / Watch = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯（观察）：本期复核 90 日内仍无评级机构对 CoreWeave / Nebius / Nscale / Lambda / Crusoe 的已确认降级或违约、亦无压力交换（Moody's 反而给 CoreWeave Compute 结构性主体 A3）。压力集中在市场定价一侧——CoreWeave 5 年期 CDS 约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率，月内 CoreWeave -36%、Nebius -43%；Q1 利息支出翻倍至 $5.36 亿、FCF -$47.1 亿、债务本金 $251 亿，而 2026 年需 $310-350 亿 capex 对应约 $62 亿 TTM 收入。反向支撑：Nebius 现金 $93.7 亿、流动性稳。已确认事件门槛未破，故不转红，但这是信用轴上唯一持续冒烟的火星
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow (Watch): re-checked this run, there is still no confirmed rating-agency downgrade, default or distressed exchange at CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, Lambda or Crusoe within 90 days — Moody's in fact assigned A3 to a structured CoreWeave Compute entity. The stress sits entirely in market pricing: CoreWeave's five-year CDS is around 855bps, implying a ~50% default probability, with the stock down 36% on the month and Nebius down 43%; Q1 interest expense doubled to $536M, free cash flow was -$4.71B and debt principal $25.1B, against a 2026 capex need of $31-35B on roughly $6.2B of trailing revenue. On the other side, Nebius holds $9.37B of cash with stable liquidity. The confirmed-event threshold is intact so this does not turn red, but it is the one cell on the credit axis that keeps smoking

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >=70% red / 50-70% yellow / <50% green (dot-com peak: 80-100%)
indicators.note: 周度增量台账（距 8/9 完整对账 8 天、未到 28 天）：分子维持 MS 全口径 2026E 新增 AI 债务约 $5700 亿、分母全口径 capex 约 $1.04 万亿，比值约 55%（区间 50-60%），维持黄灯。本周新增 $0.44B——Global AI 的 $4.41 亿债务融资（JPMorgan 牵头、8/10 公告），无单笔 ≥$10B 的 deal；台账年内可追溯流水累计约 $129.0B。边际信息在价不在量：Morningstar 本期报支撑 AI 投资的债券发行已破 $2500 亿并在测试投资者需求上限，hyperscaler 债认购覆盖率由 2 月约 5 倍降至 7 月不足 2 倍，边际融资正由公开债市转向私募信用（MS 估私募信用将供给 $1.5 万亿缺口中最大的一块、约 $8000 亿）
indicators.note_en: Weekly incremental ledger (eight days since the Aug 9 full reconciliation, short of 28): the numerator holds at Morgan Stanley's all-in 2026E new AI debt of ~$570B over ~$1.04T of all-in capex, giving ~55% (a 50-60% band) — yellow. This week adds $0.44B, the $441M debt facility for Global AI led by JPMorgan and announced Aug 10, with no single deal at or above $10B; the traceable ledger flow for the year now totals about $129.0B. The marginal information is in price, not volume: Morningstar reported this period that bond issuance backing AI investment has passed $250B and is testing the ceiling of investor demand, with coverage on hyperscaler bond deals falling from roughly 5x in February to under 2x by July as the marginal dollar shifts from public bonds to private credit (Morgan Stanley expects private credit to supply the largest slice of the $1.5T gap, around $800B)
indicators.source_name: Morgan Stanley + 自下而上台账 / Morningstar

indicators.name_zh: AI 行业 Token 月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contraction = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 停更约 10-12 周后，本期首次恢复真实绝对量：prefetch 走 OpenRouter 官方 datasets API（rankings-daily，2025-01 起日度全量），近 30 日 275.0 万亿 tokens、前 30 日 218.5 万亿，环比 +25.9%（数据截至 8/16，覆盖 70 天）；日度尾部 8/10-8/16 为 10.6/10.9/11.2/11.1/11.5/9.6/10.4 万亿。此前数期挂的「约 100-125T/月」是 5-7 月旧口径的估算沿用，真实量级比它高一倍以上——行业 token 消耗不仅没有收缩，还在两位数加速。交叉印证：OpenAI 7 月单月 run rate 环比 +20%。维持绿灯，suspect_static 解除
indicators.note_en: After roughly 10-12 weeks without a real absolute reading, this period restores one: the prefetch job pulls OpenRouter's official datasets API (rankings-daily, full daily coverage since January 2025), showing 275.0 trillion tokens over the last 30 days against 218.5 trillion in the prior 30, a +25.9% increase through Aug 16 across 70 days of data; the daily tail for Aug 10-16 runs 10.6/10.9/11.2/11.1/11.5/9.6/10.4 trillion. The '~100-125T per month' carried in recent periods was an estimate anchored to May-July figures, and the true level is more than double it — industry token consumption is not merely failing to contract, it is accelerating at a double-digit rate. Cross-check: OpenAI's July run rate grew 20% month over month. Green, and the suspect-static flag is cleared

indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌>15%/供过于求=红 / 阴跌=黄 / 稳定或上涨=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: -15%+ MoM / glut = red / Drifting lower = yellow / Stable-to-rising = green
indicators.note: 本期实抓价点：H100 on-demand 跨 15+ 家提供商 $1.49（Vast.ai）-$6.98（Azure）、JarvisLabs $2.69，H100 spot 约 $1.03-2.00；H200 on-demand $3.99（JarvisLabs）、跨提供商约 $3.82-10.60，H200 spot 在 RunPod/Vast 约 $3.50-4.40。与台账上期（H100 on-demand $2.19-2.69、H200 $3.99/spot $1.99）对比无环比下跌、无普遍过剩，维持绿灯。首次出现的软信号：Blackwell 放量与新增供给已让市场对 8 月底 H200 租价出现分歧（预测市场把赔率密集摆在 $4-6/hr 区间），这是本指标转黄最可能的路径，下期需盯
indicators.note_en: Price points pulled this run: H100 on-demand spans $1.49 (Vast.ai) to $6.98 (Azure) across 15-plus providers with JarvisLabs at $2.69, and H100 spot sits near $1.03-2.00; H200 on-demand is $3.99 at JarvisLabs and roughly $3.82-10.60 across providers, with H200 spot around $3.50-4.40 on RunPod and Vast. Against the prior ledger (H100 on-demand $2.19-2.69, H200 $3.99 on-demand / $1.99 spot) there is no sequential decline and no broad glut — green. One new soft signal: the Blackwell ramp and fresh supply have opened genuine disagreement about where H200 rates land by late August, with prediction-market odds clustered across the $4-6/hr bands. That is the most plausible route to a yellow here and is worth watching next period

indicators.name_zh: AI 收入增速的二阶导
indicators.threshold_text: 减速=红 / 平稳=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decel = red / Flat = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 维持平稳/黄，本期无新披露、判定沿用上期台账：OpenAI 年化 run rate 破 $400 亿（较 2025 底约 $200 亿翻倍）、Brockman 称 7 月单月环比 +20%，明确再加速；Anthropic 约 $741 亿但月增量已由 +$170 亿回落至 +$45 亿、二阶导仍负。本期新增的只是口径提醒——Anthropic 按 gross 口径记收入（含云分销商端到端消费），OpenAI 更接近 net，OpenAI 方称这一差异令对比高估约 $80 亿；两家不同口径混合后，二阶导仍是一加一减的对冲，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: Stays flat/yellow with no fresh disclosure this period, carrying last period's ledger: OpenAI's annualized run rate has topped $40B (roughly double the ~$20B at end-2025) with President Brockman citing 20%-plus month-over-month growth in July, a clear re-acceleration; Anthropic is near $74.1B but its monthly increment has eased from +$17B to +$4.5B, leaving its second derivative negative. What is new is only a definitional caveat — Anthropic books revenue gross, counting end-customer spend through cloud resellers, while OpenAI reports closer to net, and OpenAI argues the difference overstates the comparison by about $8B. Blending the two, the second derivative remains one up and one down — yellow

indicators.threshold_text_en: <50% red / 50-65% yellow / >65% green
indicators.note: 季度调查、本期无新 Q2/Q3 整体读数，沿用 McKinsey Q1 2026：72% 企业至少 1 项 AI workload 已生产化（2024 为 55%、2020 为 20%）。本期补充的分层数据：AI agent 口径生产化仅 31%（S&P Global/McKinsey；银行保险 47% 领先、医疗 18% 与政府 14% 垫底），Gartner 预计 2026 年底 40% 企业应用会内嵌任务型 agent（2025 不足 5%）。总体部署率高位维持绿灯，但「部署广、价值捕获窄」的裂口是这条线上真正的隐忧
indicators.note_en: A quarterly survey with no new Q2/Q3 headline print this period, so McKinsey's Q1 2026 figure carries: 72% of enterprises run at least one AI workload in production, up from 55% in 2024 and 20% in 2020. New detail beneath it: on the narrower agent definition only 31% have one in production (S&P Global/McKinsey), led by banking and insurance at 47% and trailed by healthcare at 18% and government at 14%, while Gartner expects 40% of enterprise applications to embed task-specific agents by end-2026 versus under 5% in 2025. The headline rate stays high — green, though the gap between broad deployment and narrow value capture is the real worry on this line

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 订单积压维持纪录且加速（季度指标、本期无新披露）：MSFT 商业 RPO $6780 亿（+84% YoY）、Amazon RPO $4960 亿（环比 +$1320 亿）、Google 积压 $5140 亿、Oracle RPO $6380 亿，大三 hyperscaler 合计约 $1.69 万亿。增速排序 Oracle 63% > MSFT 34% > AWS 20%。订单强劲且加速，维持绿灯——Oracle 积压高度集中于 OpenAI 仍是这格里最大的结构性隐患
indicators.note_en: Backlogs remain at records and accelerating (a quarterly measure with no new disclosure this period): MSFT commercial RPO stands at $678B (+84% YoY), Amazon's RPO at $496B (up $132B sequentially), Google's backlog at $514B and Oracle's RPO at $638B, putting the big three hyperscalers near $1.69T combined. Growth ranks Oracle at 63%, MSFT at 34% and AWS at 20%. The order book is strong and accelerating — green, though Oracle's heavy concentration in OpenAI remains the largest structural risk in this cell

indicators.threshold_text: 停滞=红 / 放缓=黄 / 正常或加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Stalled = red / Decelerating = yellow / On-trend or accelerating = green
indicators.note: 三层判定，本期含一处台账修正。主锚：METR 官方 Time Horizon 1.1 给出的倍增时间为 196 天（约 7 个月），与 2019-2025 全期估计一致——台账此前记的「约 4 个月」实为 2024 年起子区间口径，本期按官方全期口径修正为 7 个月，仍卡在「≤7 个月轨道=绿」的边界上，这是本指标向黄靠近的第一处松动。辅锚：ARC-AGI-2 公开榜 GPT-5.5 约 85%（次为 GPT-5.4 Pro 83%、Gemini 3.1 Pro 77%）已逼近饱和，按 INDICATORS 规则下期起追踪对象轮换至 ARC-AGI-3；FrontierMath Tier1-3 51.7% / Tier4 35.4%（GPT-5.5）；HLE SOTA 约 53.3%、一年 +30pp；SWE-bench Pro 约 80.3%。佐证：近 90 天旗舰密集（Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol、Grok 4.5，及 8/14 中国开源 GLM-5.3 / Qwen3.8），无连续两季度无实质提升。维持绿灯，但「倍增时间口径修正到 7 月 + 主力基准饱和换代」两件事叠加，使这条线的绿是全表最需要下期复核的一格
indicators.note_en: A three-layer read that includes one ledger correction this period. Primary anchor: METR's official Time Horizon 1.1 puts the doubling time at 196 days, about seven months, matching the full 2019-2025 estimate — the '~4 months' previously carried in the ledger was the post-2024 sub-period, and it is corrected here to the official full-sample figure. Seven months sits exactly on the 'within a 7-month track equals green' boundary, the first loosening toward yellow on this line. Secondary anchors: GPT-5.5 leads the public ARC-AGI-2 board at roughly 85% (GPT-5.4 Pro 83%, Gemini 3.1 Pro 77%), close enough to saturation that the spec calls for rotating to ARC-AGI-3 from next period; FrontierMath stands at 51.7% on Tiers 1-3 and 35.4% on Tier 4 for GPT-5.5; HLE SOTA is ~53.3% after a 30-point gain in a year; SWE-bench Pro is ~80.3%. Corroboration: flagship releases stayed dense over 90 days (Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Grok 4.5, plus the Chinese open models GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.8 on Aug 14), with no two consecutive quarters lacking real gains. Green — but the doubling-time correction to seven months landing alongside the saturation of the headline benchmark makes this the greenest cell most in need of re-checking next period

indicators.threshold_text: 任何=红 / 调查=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any confirmed = red / Investigation = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 本期复核仍无针对核心 AI 龙头的正式立案或已确认事件，维持绿灯。监管侧软信号继续硬化：SEC 8/5 新设的「财报与会计执法单元」已被律师界描述为「回归基本功」的执法转向并开始落地，SEC 审查部同时确认 AI 为 2026 年常设检查优先项、明确核查发行人对自身 AI 能力表述的准确性。现有 round-tripping（Nvidia→OpenAI→CoreWeave/Oracle）仍停留在分析师与媒体审视层面——本期新增的只是规模口径（多家统计把循环资金环置于 $800B 以上）。工具箱已就位、案子尚未来，这是绿灯里最脆的一格
indicators.note_en: Re-checked this run with still no formal case or confirmed event against a core AI bellwether — green. The regulatory soft signal keeps hardening: the Financial Reporting and Accounting Unit the SEC stood up on Aug 5 is now described by securities lawyers as a 'back-to-basics' enforcement turn already being put into action, while the Division of Examinations confirms AI as a standing 2026 exam priority with staff specifically checking the accuracy of registrants' claims about their own AI capabilities. Existing round-tripping concerns (Nvidia to OpenAI to CoreWeave and Oracle) remain at the level of analyst and press scrutiny; the only new element this period is scale, with several tallies now placing the circular loop above $800B. The toolkit is in place and the case has not arrived — the most brittle green on the board
indicators.source_name: Global Investigations Review / PKF O'Connor Davies

indicators.value_display: 维持高利率 (维持 67.6% / 加息 32%)
indicators.threshold_text: 加息=红 / 通胀压力=黄 / 降息=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike = red / Inflation pressure = yellow / Cut = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，且本期边际由鹰转缓：9/16 会议 CME FedWatch 隐含「维持 3.50-3.75%」概率回到 67.6%、加息 32%，较上期约 50/50 的五五开明显回撤（上期为全期最接近红线的一次）。背景仍不轻松——7 月会议以 9:3 投票维持，通胀黏性与供应链扰动令加息辩论未息，部分卖方（Chase）仍在标题层面写「9 月加息已成预期」，与 FedWatch 的模态读数相左。按规则模态仍是维持、非隐含加息，维持黄灯；这也意味着与 2000-02 向量收窄最快的那条差异，本期反而重新拉开了一点
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow, and the margin turned less hawkish this period: CME FedWatch now implies a 67.6% chance the Sept 16 meeting holds at 3.50-3.75% against a 32% chance of a hike, a clear step back from last period's near coin flip, which had been the closest this run has come to the red line. The backdrop is not comfortable — July's meeting held on a 9-3 vote, sticky inflation and supply-chain disruption keep the hike debate alive, and some sell-side commentary (Chase) still headlines a September hike as the expected outcome, at odds with FedWatch's modal read. By the rule the modal outcome remains a hold rather than an implied hike, so yellow stands; it also means the gap versus the February 2000 vector that had been closing fastest widened slightly back out this period

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚=红 / 偶发=黄 / 奖励=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment = red / Episodic = yellow / Rewarded = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯：Q2 财报季已结束、本期无新 capex 指引可读，沿用「选择性/偶发惩罚」——市场奖励有需求佐证的 capex（MSFT/Amazon），只惩罚烧现金无对价者（Meta）。本期新增的是预期面读数：卖方普遍把 Mag7 的核心担忧定位在「不断抬升的资本预算」，2026 年该组内部已现分化（Amazon capex $200B 将超其经营现金流），但同时把 Nvidia 与 Meta 列为仍能领跑 2027 的两家。反应函数仍在红黄之间，Nvidia 8/26 财报是下一个真实读点
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow: Q2 season is closed with no new capex guidance to read this period, so the 'selective/episodic punishment' call carries — the market rewards capex backed by demand (MSFT, Amazon) and punishes only cash burn without receipts (Meta). What is new is on the expectations side: the sell side now locates the core Mag7 worry squarely in ever-rising capital budgets, and 2026 has split the group (Amazon's $200B of capex is set to exceed its operating cash flow), even while naming Nvidia and Meta as the two still built to lead into 2027. The reaction function sits between red and yellow, and Nvidia's Aug 26 print is the next genuine read

indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热=红 / 部分=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widespread acknowledgment = red / Partial = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 对冲表态继续扩散但仍未成一致，维持黄灯。承认侧本期已到三人：Altman 对 The Verge 直言「投资者整体对 AI 过度兴奋」、称三人团队募数亿美元的估值「疯了」；Pichai 对 BBC 说 AI 运动中存在「非理性」、投资周期可能「overshoot」、且「没有公司能幸免，包括我们」；Dimon 称自己「比多数人更担心」市场回调、承认这些钱「很可能有一大部分会亏掉」。反向侧仍由 Huang 独扛——称泡沫忧虑相较「人类史上最大基建潮」微不足道。关键判据未变：无一家在承认过热的同时收缩支出，capex 仍在集体加码，故不转红
indicators.note_en: Hedging keeps spreading but is still not unanimous — yellow. Three names now sit on the acknowledging side: Altman told The Verge that investors as a whole are overexcited about AI and called valuations for three-person teams raising hundreds of millions 'insane'; Pichai told the BBC he sees irrationality in parts of the AI movement, that the investment cycle could overshoot, and that no company will be immune, including his own; Dimon says he is far more worried than others about a correction and concedes a lot of this money will probably be lost. On the other side Huang stands largely alone, arguing bubble fears are dwarfed by the largest infrastructure build-out in human history. The decisive test is unchanged: nobody is conceding an overheated market while cutting spend, and capex is still being raised across the board — so this does not turn red
